description: This file contains implementations of functions that return system uptime in milliseconds and seconds based on the monotonic clock, specifically 'tu_uptime_msecs' and 'tu_uptime_secs'. It serves as a container for non-POSIX compliant time functions related to uptime measurement.

methods.name: uint32_t tu_uptime_msecs(void)
methods.description: Returns the number of milliseconds since the system was last booted, using clock_gettime with CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

methods.name: uint32_t tu_uptime_secs(void)
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the system was last booted, using clock_gettime with CLOCK_MONOTONIC.
